name: measured-v3g-lowglare
how: One OpenPaper L, photographed showing a calibration chart: 6 daylight RAW photos, decoded linearly. inks_as_photographed: white-adapted linear RGB of the solid patches (median of the photos, room glare included: black reads Y 0.17). inks: the same with a uniform glare offset, assumed neutral, removed so black reads Y 0.06 (an assumption, not a measurement); green's blue channel is then halved, from one photo of the frame where green in fine patterns read yellow-green (the solid green patch reads teal). L: area a pixel loses at k = 1..4 (L(0) = 0), fitted on all black/white chart regions. D: spread weight of the neighbour ink (column) into the pixel ink (row), fitted on the chart's 12 two-ink checkerboards. Order of inks: black, white, blue, green, red, yellow.
